description: Guidance for the 'Add Purpose - Irrigation' step in a Water Licence Application. Covers sub-purpose selection, quantity calculation rules, and data entry guidance only for Irrigation.

sub_purposes.name: Irrigation
sub_purposes.explanation: Water is used for irrigation purposes other than those provided by a local provider.

sub_purposes.name: Irrigation - Water conveyed by local provider
sub_purposes.explanation: Water is supplied by a local provider for irrigation purposes within the local provider's service area.
sub_purposes.notes: Select this sub-purpose when water is supplied by a local provider. See the definition of 'local provider' in the Water Sustainability Fees, Rentals and Charges Tariff Regulation.

references.title: Water Sustainability Fees, Rentals and Charges Tariff Regulation

rules.name: Irrigated Area Data Entry Guidance
rules.instruction: Applicants must enter only the irrigated area size, not the total land size.
rules.warning: Do not enter entire land parcel size if only a portion is irrigated.
rules.reason: Using total land size instead of irrigated area may result in incorrect water requirement calculations.
